name: juicebot-dev
description: [dev build] Geenee: AI control of a genome workspace with the igv genome browser and the Juicebox Hi-C contact-map viewer side by side. Search ENCODE/4DN, load maps and tracks, navigate genes and loci, compare, share. Connects to the Aiden Lab's hosted MCP server; nothing runs locally.

interface.longDescription: Drive Geenee by typing plain requests: one page beside the chat holds the igv genome browser and the Juicebox Hi-C contact-map viewer. Search ENCODE and 4DN for maps and tracks, load them, navigate to genes and loci, compare views, and share links. The page opens in a browser tab that must stay open while you work. Connects to the Aiden Lab's hosted MCP server; no account is needed.
defaultPrompt: Open Geenee and load the GM12878 Hi-C map at the HOXA cluster.
In IGV go to MYC and add a CTCF ChIP-seq track for K562.
Create a link I can share showing this view.
